intro.title: Bounty Hunting - Skyline Valley Head Hunt Boss Stats
intro.blurb: Each Skyline Valley Head Hunt boss comes with a distinct weapon setup and a signature mechanic, and the gang they bring follows the same theme. This page lists every boss by group with their weapons, health, damage and resistances, plus the gang members and support waves that fight alongside them. All numbers are read straight from the game files and update with every patch.
intro.profiles: Bosses are grouped the same way as the Skyline Valley Head Hunt Groups lifetime challenges. Track your kills on the Grunt Hunt and Head Hunt Challenges page.
intro.mutations: Mutation effects used by bounty targets. One-star outlaws are named after theirs, and some Head Hunt bosses carry a forced mutation as part of their signature attack.
intro.mechanics: Skyline Valley Head Hunt bosses share the following stats.
intro.health: Health is read from the curve table assigned to each boss across the bounty level range. Bosses on the same curve share a row.
intro.damage: Damage per hit from each boss's main weapon at the bottom and top of the bounty level range.
intro.support: Every Skyline Valley Head Hunt sends one of these support waves alongside the boss and its gang. Blood Eagles are the usual wave; a few bosses bring a different one that suits their theme.
intro.npcs: Each boss brings its own gang members, listed with the boss they belong to.
